# SAS
> SAS provides analytics, AI, and data management software, documentation, and learning resources centered on SAS Viya and related platforms.

SAS publishes product documentation, API and programming references, tutorials, training, support resources, industry solutions, and customer stories across its global site. The most useful LLM-oriented entry points are the documentation portal, developer resources, support knowledge base, software downloads, and product pages for SAS Viya, analytics, and AI.

## Documentation
- [SAS Documentation](https://documentation.sas.com/): Central portal for SAS product documentation, administration guides, and programming references.
- [SAS Viya Documentation](https://documentation.sas.com/?cdcId=viya-platfrom): Documentation hub for SAS Viya platform concepts, deployment, administration, and usage.
- [SAS 9.4 Documentation](https://documentation.sas.com/?cdcId=pgmsascdc&cdcVersion=9.4): Reference and user documentation for Base SAS and SAS 9.4 products.
- [Documentation by Product](https://documentation.sas.com/doc/en/): Browse SAS documentation collections by product family and release.
- [SAS Viya Administration](https://documentation.sas.com/doc/en/itopscdc/default/itopssr/titlepage.htm): Administering SAS Viya environments, services, security, and operations.
- [SAS Programming Documentation](https://documentation.sas.com/?cdcId=pgmsascdc): Programming guides and references for SAS language, procedures, and data access.

## Developer Resources
- [SAS Developer](https://developer.sas.com/): Developer portal for APIs, SDKs, open source integrations, and SAS Viya development resources.
- [SAS Viya APIs](https://developer.sas.com/apis): API catalog and developer information for SAS Viya services.
- [SAS Viya SDKs](https://developer.sas.com/sdks): SDK resources for building applications with SAS platforms and services.
- [SAS Open Source](https://developer.sas.com/open-source): Guidance for integrating SAS with Python, R, and other open source tools.
- [SAS Viya CLI](https://developer.sas.com/tools/viya-cli): Command-line tooling for managing and automating SAS Viya environments.
- [SAS for Python Developers](https://developer.sas.com/guides/python): Python integration guidance for accessing SAS analytics and services.

## APIs and Integration
- [SAS REST APIs](https://developer.sas.com/rest-apis): REST API resources for SAS Viya services and platform integration.
- [SAS Logon and Authentication](https://developer.sas.com/apis/rest/Authentication): Authentication concepts and endpoints for SAS API access.
- [SAS Job Execution APIs](https://developer.sas.com/apis/rest/JobExecution): APIs for running and managing SAS jobs programmatically.
- [SAS Micro Analytic Service APIs](https://developer.sas.com/apis/rest/MicroAnalyticService): Endpoints for publishing and executing analytic models and decisions.
- [SAS Visual Analytics APIs](https://developer.sas.com/apis/rest/VisualAnalytics): API resources for reports, content, and analytics interactions.
- [SAS Model Manager APIs](https://developer.sas.com/apis/rest/ModelManager): Programmatic access to model lifecycle and governance capabilities.

## Products
- [SAS Viya](https://www.sas.com/en_us/software/viya.html): Cloud-native analytics and AI platform for data, modeling, and decisioning.
- [SAS Visual Analytics](https://www.sas.com/en_us/software/visual-analytics.html): Self-service analytics, dashboards, and reporting for business users and analysts.
- [SAS Data Management](https://www.sas.com/en_us/software/data-management.html): Data integration, quality, governance, and preparation capabilities.
- [SAS Customer Intelligence](https://www.sas.com/en_us/software/customer-intelligence.html): Marketing, personalization, and customer journey analytics solutions.
- [SAS Risk Management](https://www.sas.com/en_us/software/risk-management.html): Risk analytics and decisioning for financial services and regulated industries.
- [SAS Fraud Management](https://www.sas.com/en_us/software/fraud-management.html): Fraud detection and investigation solutions using analytics and AI.
- [SAS Intelligent Decisioning](https://www.sas.com/en_us/software/intelligent-decisioning.html): Decision automation combining business rules, analytics, and model deployment.
- [SAS Model Manager](https://www.sas.com/en_us/software/model-manager.html): Model governance, monitoring, and lifecycle management for analytics teams.

## Learning and Tutorials
- [SAS Learn](https://www.sas.com/en_us/learn.html): Learning hub for training, tutorials, certifications, and educational resources.
- [SAS Training](https://www.sas.com/en_us/training.html): Instructor-led and self-paced training for SAS software and analytics topics.
- [SAS Tutorials](https://www.sas.com/en_us/learn/tutorials.html): Introductory tutorials for SAS programming, analytics, and platform usage.
- [SAS Certifications](https://www.sas.com/en_us/certification.html): Certification paths and exam information for SAS users and administrators.
- [SAS Academic Programs](https://www.sas.com/en_us/learn/academic-programs.html): Resources for students, educators, and academic institutions using SAS.
- [SAS Skill Builder for Students](https://www.sas.com/en_us/learn/academic-programs/students.html): Student-focused learning resources and free access options.

## Support
- [SAS Support](https://support.sas.com/): Main support portal for downloads, hot fixes, knowledge base, and technical resources.
- [SAS Knowledge Base](https://support.sas.com/kb/): Searchable technical notes, problem reports, and usage guidance.
- [SAS Downloads](https://support.sas.com/downloads/): Software downloads, deployment tools, and related installation resources.
- [SAS Hot Fixes](https://support.sas.com/en/downloads/hot-fixes.html): Product hot fixes and maintenance updates for supported SAS software.
- [SAS Samples and SAS Notes](https://support.sas.com/resources/papers/proceedings.html): Technical papers, examples, and conference proceedings for SAS users.
- [SAS Communities](https://communities.sas.com/): User community forums for questions, best practices, and peer support.

## Solutions and Industries
- [Industry Solutions](https://www.sas.com/en_us/industry.html): Overview of SAS solutions tailored to major industries and business domains.
- [Banking](https://www.sas.com/en_us/industry/banking.html): Analytics, risk, fraud, and compliance solutions for banks and lenders.
- [Government](https://www.sas.com/en_us/industry/government.html): Public sector analytics for program integrity, security, and service delivery.
- [Health Care and Life Sciences](https://www.sas.com/en_us/industry/health-care.html): Analytics for clinical, operational, and population health use cases.
- [Insurance](https://www.sas.com/en_us/industry/insurance.html): Pricing, claims, fraud, and risk solutions for insurers.
- [Manufacturing](https://www.sas.com/en_us/industry/manufacturing.html): Industrial analytics for quality, forecasting, and operational optimization.
- [Retail](https://www.sas.com/en_us/industry/retail.html): Customer, merchandising, and supply chain analytics for retailers.

## Resources and Insights
- [Resource Center](https://www.sas.com/en_us/resources.html): Collection of white papers, e-books, webinars, and analyst reports.
- [SAS Blogs](https://blogs.sas.com/): Official SAS blogs covering analytics, AI, programming, and industry topics.
- [Customer Stories](https://www.sas.com/en_us/customers.html): Case studies and success stories from organizations using SAS solutions.
- [Events](https://www.sas.com/en_us/events.html): Conferences, webinars, and virtual events hosted by SAS.
- [Newsroom](https://www.sas.com/en_us/news.html): Company announcements, press releases, and media resources.
- [Analyst Reports and Research](https://www.sas.com/en_us/resources/analyst-report.html): Research and analyst content related to analytics and AI markets.

- [About SAS](https://www.sas.com/en_us/company-information.html): Corporate overview, mission, history, and company information.
- [Leadership](https://www.sas.com/en_us/company-information/leadership.html): Executive leadership profiles and organizational leadership information.
- [Careers](https://www.sas.com/en_us/careers.html): Job opportunities, culture, benefits, and recruiting information.
